about: Carleton Place is a town in Lanark County, Ontario, on the Mississippi River west of Ottawa. Mill-town heritage, a lively Bridge Street downtown, and a role as a growing Ottawa-valley community define the town at the river’s falls and islands. About 13,000 people live in Carleton Place.
seoSummary: Lanark County town on the Mississippi River west of Ottawa—mill heritage and growing Ottawa-valley Main Street.
